problem.statement: Support conversations, operational incidents and order rescue require one governed DSH truth instead of disconnected or local-only controls.
problem.currentWorkaround: Operators may need to correlate support tickets, incident status and blocked orders across separate surfaces when the canonical rescue flow is incomplete.

permittedActions: create support ticket for owned store or order
open support conversation for assigned order
open and resolve order rescue case
forbiddenActions: mutate WLT ledger or balance from DSH

outcome.statement: Every support, incident and order rescue action produces one authorized DSH effect and an immediate governed readback without local operational truth.
outcome.baselineState: Support, incident and rescue capabilities must converge on one state-machine, audit and readback model rather than disconnected local controls.
outcome.targetState: Support, incidents and rescue use retry-safe state machines, append-only audit and role-scoped readback.
outcome.observationWindow: same-commit affected runtime, QA and product verification cycle

criteria: Actor support access is owner scoped and internal notes do not leak.
Support message attachments and read receipts are registered and route-tested where required by the current contract.
Incident mutations require idempotency context and valid expected-state transitions.
Order rescue cases are linked to a real order and reject duplicate active cases.
Resolution and closure require governed operator evidence.
Incident and rescue audit events are append-only and readable by authorized operators.
WLT access from rescue is visibility-only and cannot mutate financial truth.

business: One active rescue case exists per order under the current state model.
Every mutation preserves one idempotency key and correlation identity where the contract requires them.
All transitions produce canonical readback and an audit event where required.
Internal support notes are visible only to authorized operators.
WLT remains the sole owner of financial truth.
negative: No actor can read another actor support ticket.
No closed rescue case reopens unless the current state machine explicitly defines a legal transition.
No incident or rescue transition silently overwrites stale state.
No production mock or local array represents support, incident or rescue truth.
No DSH rescue action mutates WLT ledger, balance, refund or settlement truth.

execution.appetite: Close code gaps without expanding into financial mutation, production deployment or platform activation.
fixedConstraints: Repository truth is the current user-named work branch and resolved immutable candidate SHA.
DSH shared support owns frontend business coordination only where current source confirms it.
WLT remains read-only from DSH order-rescue support paths except through WLT-owned financial operations.
No automatic PR, merge, force push, release or production deployment is authorized by this contract.
forbiddenScope: WLT ledger mutation from DSH rescue
execution.forecastRange: one bounded implementation and evidence cycle
unknowns: Production provider and deployment evidence when applicable
